verdict.rationale: Synctera is a banking-as-a-service platform, so cross-border money movement is a fair axis. The evidence only documents domestic wires between two US-based accounts over Fedwire, plus ACH and internal transfers. There is no evidence of international wires, SWIFT, FX rates, or a currency/corridor coverage map.

support.subject: As a founder, money can cross borders — international wires or SWIFT, FX with transparent rates, and the coverage map of currencies and corridors documented
